{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a premium static Vue website for a nature photography print shop / editorial magazine called "Wildframe Journal". The site should feel like a Dribbble-quality concept: elegant, airy, editorial, nature-inspired, with a luxury e-commerce look for selling fine art landscape and wildlife photo prints. No backend, no login, no cart logic needed beyond visual/static mockups. Use static/sample content only.

## Overall Style
- Visual direction: nature, organic, calm, premium photography editorial
- Inspiration: Dribbble-style layouts, large cinematic image blocks, magazine grids, clean spacing
- Color palette:
  - Deep forest green #10251C
  - Moss green #63795B
  - Warm sand #E8DDC9
  - Cloud white #F8F6F0
  - Charcoal text #20231F
  - Accent amber #C88A3D
- Typography:
  - Elegant serif for headlines
  - Clean sans-serif for UI/body text
- Use soft shadows, subtle grain texture, rounded image cards, editorial dividers, delicate line icons
- Must be fully responsive for desktop/tablet/mobile

## Required Interaction
### Sticky Navigation
Create a sticky nav that stays at the top while scrolling.
Nav contents:
- Logo: Wildframe Journal
- Links: Home, Prints, Stories, Collections, About, Contact
- Right side: Search icon visual only, Bag icon visual only, CTA button “Shop Prints”
Mobile: hamburger menu style is ok, but it can be static/visual or simple open-close front-end state only.

## Page Structure
Create a single-page static editorial e-commerce website with these sections:

---

# 1. Hero Section
Left side:
Small eyebrow badge: "Limited Edition Nature Prints"
Main headline:
"Bring the quiet power of the wild into your space."
Description:
"Museum-grade photography prints from forests, coastlines, mountains, and protected habitats — curated like an editorial journal and crafted for calm interiors."
CTA buttons:
- Shop New Prints
- Read Field Notes
Trust text:
"Archival paper • Carbon-neutral packaging • Signed editions"

Right side:
Large featured photo card mockup with layered editorial elements:
- Main nature photo placeholder
- Floating tag: "New Series: Alpine Silence"
- Floating mini card with print size and price: "24×36 in • From $180"
- Tiny photographer credit strip

Background:
Soft organic blobs, subtle leaf pattern or contour-line texture.

---

# 2. Featured Product Strip
Title: "Collector Favorites"
Show 4 static product cards:
1. Mist Valley — Forest Print — $140
2. Golden Elk — Wildlife Print — $220
3. Tidal Quiet — Coastline Print — $165
4. Alpine Blue — Mountain Print — $190
Each card should include:
- Image placeholder
- Category
- Product title
- Price
- Small pill labels like "Limited", "Signed", "Best Seller"
- Static visual button "View Print"

No real checkout. Just static product presentation.

---

# 3. Editorial Feature Section
Create a magazine-like split layout.
Headline:
"Stories behind the frame"
Body copy about field notes, conservation, weather, patience, and natural light.
Include 3 article teaser cards:
- "Photographing fog before sunrise"
- "Why old-growth forests change the image"
- "The soft palette of northern coastlines"
Each has image placeholder, date, short excerpt, read more link.

Make this feel like an editorial site, not a normal store.

---

# 4. Shop by Collection
Grid section with 6 collection tiles:
- Forest Studies
- Mountain Light
- Coastal Silence
- Wildlife Portraits
- Desert Warmth
- Winter Minimalism
Each tile should have:
- Large photo background
- Overlay title
- Number of prints, e.g. "18 prints"
- Hover effect if possible: image zoom + overlay darkens

---

# 5. Product Detail Highlight
Create one large featured product layout for:
"Cedar Rain No. 04"
Static content:
- Edition: 1 of 75
- Sizes: 12×18, 18×24, 24×36, 30×40
- Finish: Matte archival cotton paper
- Price: From $150
- Description paragraph
- Visual quantity selector only, no functioning cart needed
- CTA button: Add to Bag (visual/static)
- Secondary link: View framing guide
Include image gallery style: one big photo and 3 small thumbnails.

---

# 6. Process / Quality Section
Title: "Printed slowly, shipped thoughtfully"
Four steps/cards:
1. Curated in small editions
2. Printed on archival paper
3. Hand inspected for tone and detail
4. Packed in recycled protective materials
Use simple icons, calm layout.

---

# 7. Conservation Banner
Create a full-width warm nature banner:
"Every print helps protect wild places"
Text: "A portion of each sale supports habitat restoration and local conservation education."
Include stat cards:
- 12 habitats supported
- 4,800 trees funded
- 100% plastic-conscious packaging
These are static numbers.

---

# 8. Testimonials / Collector Notes
Show 3 testimonial cards:
- Interior designer quote
- Collector quote
- Gallery owner quote
Make it clean and premium.
Include star icons visually if desired.

---

# 9. Newsletter Section
Title: "Receive seasonal field notes"
Description: "Monthly photo essays, print releases, and quiet nature inspiration."
Email input visual only, button "Subscribe". No real submission needed.
Add small note: "No spam. Just slow stories from wild places."

---

# 10. Footer
Footer columns:
- Wildframe Journal logo and short description
- Shop: New Prints, Best Sellers, Gift Cards, Framing
- Journal: Field Notes, Interviews, Conservation, Travel Essays
- Support: Shipping, Print Care, Returns, Contact
- Social links visual: Instagram, Pinterest, Vimeo
Include copyright 2026.

## Components / Design Requirements
- Build with Vue
- Static front-end only
- Use reusable components for product cards, article cards, collection tiles, buttons, and section headings
- Use sample/mock images or gradient placeholders if images are not available
- Smooth scrolling anchors would be nice
- Add hover effects on cards/buttons
- Add sticky nav with slight blur/glass effect after scroll if easy
- Must not require backend, API, database, authentication, or payment integration
- Must render as a static site

## Extra Polish
- Add subtle animations: fade-in sections, gentle floating hero cards, hover lift on product cards
- Use a premium editorial layout with generous whitespace
- Keep the mood quiet, natural, artistic, and high-end
- Make sure the e-commerce elements are visual/static, like a product showcase, not a working store",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
